cases.situation: Got a DM from Ben at a coffee subscription brand, Ridgeline, saying 'love your content, want to collab?' That's it. I have 45k on Instagram and I've actually been drinking their Ethiopia roast for months.
cases.reply: Hi Ben, thanks for reaching out, I've actually been drinking your Ethiopia roast for months. To put together a proper proposal, could you share what deliverables you have in mind (reel, stories, feed post), the timeline, whether there's paid usage or exclusivity involved, and the budget range? Once I have that I'll come back within a day.
cases.note: Genuine liking is mentioned once; no enthusiasm is spent before the terms are known.

cases.situation: A Rafa, de uma marca de biquínis, me mandou DM oferecendo 3 peças em troca de um reels e 3 stories. Tenho 22 mil seguidores, curti a coleção nova deles, mas não faço permuta. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500.
cases.reply: Oi, Rafa! Obrigada pelo convite, curti muito a coleção nova de vocês. Não faço conteúdo em troca de produto, porque o trabalho é o mesmo de qualquer jeito, mas topo conversar sobre um reels pago se couber no orçamento. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500. Se não der agora, boa sorte no lançamento!

cases.situation: 一个国产护肤品牌找我做小红书笔记，预算2000，但要求永久授权还能投流。我平时单篇图文报价3000，含30天授权；投流或更长授权一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。
cases.reply: 谢谢你们直接说预算。2000的话，我可以做一篇图文笔记，含30天自然流量授权，不含投流。如果需要投流或更长的授权，一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。你们大概打算投多久？我按实际需要给一个最简单的方案。
cases.note: 授权和投流是钱藏着的地方：保住底价，用缩小交付范围来匹配预算。

cases.situation: I'm a fitness creator on TikTok, 120k followers, a lot of them 16 to 20. A sports betting app, BetBlitz, offered $2,500 for one video. Their contact is Jordan. Easy money but not right for my audience.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, thanks for the offer. Sports betting isn't a fit for my audience, so I'm going to pass on this one. Wishing you a good campaign.
cases.note: Decline mismatches fast, with no lecture about their product and no counteroffer; brands talk, and a clean no protects your reputation.

cases.situation: I sent a quote to a kitchenware brand, Oakfield, on Sept 21: $900 for one TikTok featuring their cast iron pan, with 30 days of organic usage. The contact, Priya, went quiet. It's been 8 days. Worth one follow-up?
cases.reply: Hi Priya, just following up on the proposal I sent on 21 September for the Oakfield cast iron video. If the budget or timing has shifted, tell me and I'm happy to suggest a smaller option, like a story set of three. If it's not going ahead, no problem at all, and I'd be glad to hear from you for a future campaign.
cases.note: One follow-up after a week, with an easy smaller option and an easy no. If this gets silence too, treat it as a no and move on.

cases.situation: 和一个露营装备品牌谈好了：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15号到25号之间发，总价8000元，先付一半，含30天授权，不排他。对接人是小林，想发条消息把条款确认下来。
cases.reply: 小林你好，确认一下我们谈好的内容：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15日到25日之间发布，总价8000元，签约后预付50%，交付后付剩余50%，含30天授权，不排他。今天我会把预付款的发票和内容脚本发你，脚本确认后就开始拍。如果哪一项和你的理解不一样，直接告诉我。
cases.note: 条款、付款方式和授权范围都落在文字里再开工，确认消息本身就是合同的草稿。

cases.situation: A protein bar brand, Fuelwell, offered $1,200 for one YouTube integration on my running channel (80k subs). Their contract, from Nina, asks for 6 months of category exclusivity covering all nutrition brands. I already have an ongoing paid partnership with an electrolyte brand.
cases.reply: Hi Nina, thanks for sending the contract, the integration itself looks great. The one sticking point is exclusivity: I have an ongoing nutrition partnership, so six months across all nutrition brands isn't possible for me. Two options: 60 days of exclusivity on protein bars and snacks, included at $1,200, or six months on protein bars and snacks for $1,800. Which suits Fuelwell better?
cases.note: Exclusivity is where the money hides: narrow the category, price the longer term, and keep existing partners out of it.

cases.situation: Skincare brand Lumen paid $1,200 for one TikTok. They approved my script, I filmed it and did the one round of revisions in our contract on Sept 24. Now their manager Ellie wants a full reshoot with a different outfit and a new opening hook.
cases.reply: Hi Ellie, happy to help get this one right. Our contract included one round of revisions, which we used on 24 September, so a full reshoot sits outside the original scope. I can reshoot with the new outfit and hook for $400, delivered by Friday 2 October. If you'd rather stay within the current budget, I can recut the existing footage with a new text hook at no charge by tomorrow. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: Scope creep after delivery: point to the brief once, price the extra work, and offer a free smaller fix so saying yes is easy either way.

cases.situation: J'ai refusé une collab « contre produits » avec une marque de bougies et j'ai proposé une story payée à 250 euros. La responsable, Camille, m'a répondu : « D'autres créatrices le font gratuitement, vous savez. » J'ai 30 000 abonnés sur Instagram.
cases.reply: Bonjour Camille, c'est tout à fait normal, et je comprends que ça marche pour certaines. Je ne suis simplement pas la bonne personne pour cette campagne. Bonne continuation pour le lancement, et si un budget se libère plus tard, je serai ravie d'en reparler.
cases.note: Quand la marque se braque, on ne débat pas du marché : une ligne courtoise, la porte reste ouverte, et on passe à autre chose.

cases.situation: An agency, Brightloop, emailed asking my rate for 3 UGC videos they'd run as ads for a meal-kit brand, nothing posted on my own account. Their contact Marcus won't share a budget and just says 'send your rates'.
cases.reply: Hi Marcus, thanks for the details. My rate is $450 per UGC video, so $1,350 for three, with one round of revisions each. That includes 30 days of paid-ad usage; each extra 30 days is $200 per video, and running ads through my handle is priced separately. If you tell me how long the ads will run, I'll send one clean package price today.
cases.note: With UGC the money is in paid usage, so the quote separates the content fee from the usage window instead of giving one lump number.

cases.situation: 一个坚果品牌找我在小红书发一篇测评，给1500元，但要求不走蒲公英平台、私下转账，笔记里也不要标注合作，说“写成自己买的更真实”。我有3万粉，他们家的坚果我自己确实常吃。
cases.reply: 谢谢邀请，你们家的坚果我自己确实常吃。合作的内容我都会标注，这一点没法调整：粉丝是因为信任才看我的推荐，小红书对商业合作怎么标注也有自己的规则，走蒲公英下单就能按规则来。如果走蒲公英下单，一篇图文笔记1500元我可以接，含30天授权，内容照样按我平时的风格写真实感受。你看这样可以吗？不方便的话也理解，祝新品大卖。
cases.note: 只拒绝“不标注广告”这一点，不说教；标注要求以平台当前的合作规则为准，给出合规的做法和原价，让对方选。

cases.situation: A luggage brand, Voyant, agreed $2,000 for one YouTube integration on my 60k travel channel. The contract from Alex in partnerships says payment net 90 after the video goes live, nothing upfront. I normally take 50% upfront.
cases.reply: Hi Alex, thanks for sending the contract, the deliverables and usage all look good. The one change I need is the payment terms: with new partners I work with 50% on signing and 50% within 30 days of the video going live. If net 90 is fixed on your side, I could instead do the full $2,000 within 30 days of publishing, with no deposit. Which is easier for your finance team?
cases.note: Payment terms are part of the rate: name your standard, offer one fallback, and don't start filming until the signed contract reflects it.

cases.situation: A candle brand, Hearth & Co, paid me $600 per reel for three reels last autumn. Their contact Marisa wants to rebook for the holidays. I've grown from 40k to 95k followers since then and my reel rate is now $1,100.
cases.reply: Hi Marisa, so good to hear from you again, and thanks for thinking of me for the holidays. Since we last worked together my audience has grown from 40k to 95k, so my reel rate is now $1,100 with 30 days of organic usage. As a returning partner, I can do three reels for $3,000. Could you share the timeline and whether you'd want any paid usage?
cases.note: A rebooking is the natural moment to reset your rate: give the reason in one number and a small loyalty package, not last year's price.

cases.situation: 我在抖音做家居收纳，5万粉丝。一个收纳盒品牌找我挂小黄车带货，只给20%佣金，不给坑位费，还要求至少发两条视频。我两条视频的报价一般是坑位费4000元加15%佣金，含30天授权。
cases.reply: 谢谢邀请。纯佣金的合作我一般不接，因为拍视频的工作量是一样的，卖得怎么样还取决于价格和活动力度。两条视频我的报价是坑位费4000元加15%佣金，含30天自然流量授权。如果想先试试，也可以先做一条，2000元加15%佣金，看完数据再定第二条。你看哪种合适？
cases.note: 纯佣金等于让创作者承担全部风险：说明原因，给保底加佣金的方案，再给一个更小的起步选项。

cases.situation: Skincare brand Veracalm is paying me $1,500 for a reel about their new balm, and I'm due to film on Monday. The script from their contact, Theo, has me say 'it cleared my eczema in 7 days', but I don't have eczema and I've only used it for a week on dry patches.
cases.reply: Hi Theo, thanks for the script, the balm has been lovely on my dry patches this week. The one line I can't say is 'it cleared my eczema in 7 days': I don't have eczema, and it's a medical claim I can't back up. I'd suggest: 'A week in, the dry patches on my hands feel soft again.' Everything else in the script works for me. Could you confirm the change by Friday so I can film on Monday?
cases.note: Refuse the false claim, not the deal, and offer honest wording from your real use. Health claims in ads can carry rules, so check with the brand's compliance team if they push back.

cases.situation: Uma marca de café, a Serra Alta, cancelou a campanha depois que eu já tinha gravado o reels. Recebi 50% adiantado (R$ 1.200 de R$ 2.400) e agora a Bia, do marketing, pediu o sinal de volta. A cláusula 6 do contrato diz que o sinal não é reembolsável depois do início da gravação.
cases.reply: Oi, Bia, obrigada por avisar logo, entendo que os planos mudaram. Como o reels já foi gravado, o sinal de R$ 1.200 fica comigo, conforme a cláusula 6 do contrato. Se quiserem aproveitar o vídeo mais para frente, posso publicar até 15 de dezembro pelos R$ 1.200 restantes, sem gravar de novo. Me diz se isso faz sentido para vocês.
cases.note: Cancelamento depois do trabalho feito: cite a cláusula uma vez, sem drama, e ofereça um jeito de a marca ainda aproveitar o que já pagou.

cases.situation: Eine Outdoor-Marke, Gipfelwerk, lädt mich zu ihrem Launch-Event in München am Samstag, 17. Oktober, ein: vier Stunden vor Ort plus drei Instagram-Stories. Sie zahlen nur Anreise und Hotel, kein Honorar. Ich habe 35.000 Follower, nehme für drei Stories 350 Euro und für Präsenz-Events 500 Euro; die Ansprechpartnerin heißt Lena.
cases.reply: Hallo Lena, danke für die Einladung, der Launch in München klingt richtig gut. Anreise und Hotel sind ein netter Rahmen, aber kein Honorar: Für vier Stunden vor Ort berechne ich 500 Euro und für ein Set aus drei Stories 350 Euro, zusammen also 850 Euro, plus Anreise und Hotel wie von euch angeboten. Wenn das in euer Budget passt, schick mir gern den Ablauf und sag mir, ob ihr die Stories auch auf euren eigenen Kanälen nutzen wollt. Dann melde ich mich innerhalb eines Tages zurück.
cases.note: Reisekosten sind Auslagen, kein Honorar: Präsenz und Content getrennt bepreisen und die Nutzungsrechte gleich mit abfragen.

cases.situation: An outdoor gear brand, Northpine, wants me as an ambassador for three months: one reel and one story set of three every month, for $700 a month. My rates are $900 per reel and $350 per story set, with 30 days of organic usage. The contact is Grace and she hasn't mentioned exclusivity.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, thanks for thinking of me, I'd genuinely enjoy a longer run with Northpine. At my standard rates, a reel plus a story set is $1,250 a month; for a three-month commitment I can do $1,050 a month, $3,150 in total, with 30 days of organic usage on each piece. If $700 a month is the ceiling, two story sets a month fit that budget exactly. Could you also confirm whether the ambassador role comes with any exclusivity?
cases.note: A long-term deal earns a modest package rate, not your per-post rate cut in half; and always ask about exclusivity before you sign.

cases.situation: I review budget tech on YouTube, 140k subscribers. Earbud brand Sonaro offered $2,000 for a dedicated video, and the contract from their contact Kevin includes clause 11: I can't post anything negative about Sonaro products for 12 months. I'd happily do the video, but my channel runs on honest reviews.
cases.reply: Hi Kevin, thanks for sending the contract, the fee and deliverables look good. The one clause I can't sign is clause 11: my channel runs on honest reviews, so I can't agree to say nothing negative about Sonaro for 12 months. I'm happy for your team to check the script for factual accuracy before the video goes live. Could you send a version without clause 11 so I can sign this week?
cases.note: Strike the one clause that costs your audience's trust, offer a reasonable substitute, and keep the deal. Have anyone you trust read the rest of the contract too.

cases.situation: 我是抖音探店博主，8万粉。三个月前我自费去一家茶饮店拍了条视频，播放不错。现在他们品牌的小周私信说想把这条视频转到官方账号，还想剪进广告里投流。官方号转发并@我的话我不收费；投流授权我一般按内容费的30%每90天另计，我单条视频报价5000元。
cases.reply: 小周你好，谢谢喜欢这条视频！官方账号直接转发并@我、不用于投流的话，没问题，直接转就好。如果要剪进广告投流，这部分按授权另计，每90天1500元。你们大概打算投多久？我按实际需要给你一个最简单的方案，确认后我们把授权范围写下来。
cases.note: 已经发布的旧视频也有授权问题：转发和投流分开谈，钱在投流那部分，范围要落在文字里。

cases.situation: Home fitness brand Coreline offered $1,000 for one TikTok, but only if it hits 50,000 views in 7 days; otherwise they'd pay $300. I have 70k followers and my last ten videos averaged 35,000 views. My flat rate is $900 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage, and I'd be open to a $200 bonus on top if it passes their target. The contact is Sofia.
cases.reply: Hi Sofia, thanks for the offer. I don't price on view guarantees, since reach depends on the algorithm as much as the content, but here are my numbers: my last ten videos averaged 35,000 views. My rate for one TikTok is $900 with 30 days of organic usage. If you'd like a performance element, I'm happy to add a $200 bonus if it passes 50,000 views in 7 days. Would that work for you?
cases.note: The flat fee covers the work; any upside for performance sits on top, never in place of it.

cases.situation: I post about my two rescue greyhounds on TikTok, 50k followers. Hannah from a dog treat brand, Tailwise, wants me to send three detailed video concepts plus a 15-second test clip 'so the team can decide', with no budget or deliverables mentioned yet. My rate is $850 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, thanks for reaching out, my two greyhounds would be very keen to help. I don't make test clips or full concepts before a brief is agreed, since that is the actual work, but once I know the deliverables, timeline and budget I'm happy to share a short idea direction. For reference, my rate starts at $850 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage. What did you have in mind?
cases.note: Spec work is gifting in disguise: decline the free part, keep the door open for the paid part.

cases.situation: 我是小红书美食博主，6万粉，单篇图文报价5000元，含30天授权；档期一般提前两周约，48小时内交稿加收30%加急费。一个调味品牌的对接人小米今天下午找我，说新品明晚8点前就要发一篇测评，产品今晚送到，但brief还没给。
cases.reply: 小米你好，谢谢想到我！明晚8点前发属于加急：我的档期一般提前两周约，48小时内交稿会加收30%，所以这篇图文是6500元，含30天授权。时间比较紧，麻烦今晚9点前把brief发我，我明天中午前给你初稿确认。如果发布时间能放到两周后，就按5000元正常排期。你看选哪种？
cases.note: 加急是档期成本，在报价里单独说明；同时给一个不加价的正常排期，让对方自己选。
